title: Create Hero Section Component
description: Develop a new Hero Section React component as the primary visual element for the landing page.
details:
Create a new file at components/hero-section.tsx. Build the HeroSection as a React Server Component using semantic HTML tags (
,

,

) for accessibility and SEO. Use Tailwind CSS utility classes for layout, spacing, and typography. Integrate the shadcn/ui Button component for CTAs, and wrap them with Next.js for navigation to /sign-up and any other relevant pages. Ensure the component is self-contained, visually compelling, and aligns with the existing design system. If using images or icons, leverage Next.js for optimization.
test_strategy: Write unit tests to verify that the HeroSection renders the correct headline, value proposition, and CTA buttons with the correct href attributes. Use visual regression tools or Storybook to check appearance and responsiveness across breakpoints.

title: Integrate Hero Section into Landing Page
description: Import and place the new Hero Section component at the top of the landing page.
details: Open app/page.tsx and import the HeroSection component from components/hero-section.tsx. Insert <HeroSection /> at the top of the returned JSX so it is the first visible section. Ensure the integration does not break existing layout or functionality. Confirm that navigation from the CTA buttons works as expected.
test_strategy: Manually verify that the landing page displays the Hero Section at the top and that CTA buttons navigate correctly. Run the app locally and check for layout or integration issues.

title: Ensure Responsive Design and Accessibility
description: Refine the Hero Section to ensure full responsiveness and accessibility compliance.
details: Test the HeroSection across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports. Adjust Tailwind CSS classes as needed for responsive layouts. Verify color contrast, keyboard navigation, and ARIA roles for accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA). Ensure the section is visually consistent with the rest of the site and that all interactive elements are accessible.
test_strategy: Use browser dev tools to test responsiveness. Use accessibility audit tools (e.g., Lighthouse, axe) to check compliance. Manually test keyboard navigation and screen reader output.

title: Review and Optimize Visual Assets
description: Optimize any images or graphical assets used in the Hero Section for performance.
details: If the HeroSection includes images or icons, ensure they are optimized for web (compressed, appropriate formats). Use the Next.js <Image> component for images to leverage built-in optimization. Confirm that image sizes are responsive and do not negatively impact page load times.
test_strategy: Check image loading times and sizes in browser network tab. Use Lighthouse or similar tools to audit performance. Verify that images render crisply on all devices and do not cause layout shifts.
